reviewer_notes: Generated original local PNG sprite atlases through codex-gateway-imagegen and processed them with the game-character-sprites cleanup/validation scripts.
探险家·伊泽瑞尔 is represented as an original golden arcane explorer marksman with teal gauntlet energy, not a direct copy of commercial character art.
寒冰射手·艾希 is represented as an original blue frost archer with icy cloak and crystalline bow language, not a direct copy of commercial character art.
All integrated idle/move/attack/hit/death sheets are 384x512 PNG atlases: 8 directions x 6 frames at 64px cells.

Two generated action rows drifted to the wrong hero identity, so the runtime uses same-identity generated sheets as fallback for Ezreal move and Ashe attack; validation and motion audit still pass with zero warnings.
